_README: HOW TO READ THIS FILE
Keys starting with '_' are comments: the server ignores them (Go json.Unmarshal skips unknown keys).
JSON has no // or /* */ comments: never add any, the server would refuse to start.
Tags used in the comments:
[SUBJECT] mandatory in en.subject.pdf. NOT checked by the server: check it yourself.
[RFC]     required by rfc/protocol-rfc.html.
[SERVER]  checked when the server starts: if it is wrong, the server prints world_load_failed and exits.
[TEAM]    our own rules, to keep the clients working.
[TEAM] IDs (hub, komolexos, flour, chef_gusto, fetch_beef) are what LOOK / INVENTORY send to the clients:
the GUI and CLI map them to images and texts. Change names, descriptions and dialogue freely,
add new IDs freely, but coordinate with client devs before renaming or removing an existing ID.
[TEAM] After every change, test it: cd server && go run ./cmd/server
It must print server_listening (not world_load_failed). Then play the quests with nc localhost 4242.
MINIMUM CHECKLIST [SUBJECT] (the server does not check these):
[x] at least 8 rooms, all interconnected
[x] at least one loop: a circuit you can walk around and come back (no line-only map)
[x] at least one optional branch (a side path you do not need to go through)
[x] at least 3 distinct NPC roles: dialogue, quest-giver, enemy
[x] at least 4 distinct items, at least 2 of them obtainable in the world (placed in a room)
[x] at least 2 quests (e.g. fetch an item, defeat an NPC, deliver an item)
[x] a coherent map (names, descriptions and exits make sense together)
[ ] the README 'World Design' section describes: layout, room connections, NPC roles, item distribution
_comment_start_room: [SERVER] must be an existing room id. Every player appears here after CONNECT (here: hub).
_comment_respawn_room: [SUBJECT] a player at 0 HP respawns at a safe location with reduced health (here: half of max HP).
[SERVER] must be an existing room id and must NOT contain an enemy (hostile NPC).
Can be the same room as start_room. If omitted, start_room is used.
Here: hub (safe restaurant hub with waiter and chef_gusto, no hostile enemies).
_comment_rooms: [SUBJECT] at least 8 rooms, interconnected, forming one or more loops, plus at least one optional branch.
[SUBJECT] movement must allow a full circuit (no line-only map).
[SERVER] id: not empty, unique.
[SERVER] exits: only north / south / east / west, and each one must lead to an existing room id.
[SERVER] items / npcs: must exist below; an item or an NPC can be placed in ONE room only.
[TEAM] make every exit two-way: if A has east -> B, then B must have west -> A (not checked by the server).
[TEAM] every room must be reachable from start_room (not checked by the server).
Fields:
id          stable identifier sent to the clients, e.g. hub, komolexos
name        title shown to the players (LOOK)
description one or two sentences shown to the players (LOOK)
exits       { direction: room id }
items       item ids lying on the floor when the server starts (changes with TAKE / DROP)
npcs        ids of the NPCs standing in this room
Current map (Culinary Archipelago):
[fejka (Island 5)] ----- [smycka (Island 3)] ----------+
[vinterfint (Island 4)] - [jeetomal (Island 2)] - [kuggis (Island 6)]
[komolexos (Island 1)] -- [hub (HUB)] --------- [fugoumitak (END / Island 7)]
(start/respawn)
Loops: hub-komolexos-vinterfint-jeetomal-hub, vinterfint-fejka-smycka-jeetomal-vinterfint, jeetomal-smycka-kuggis-jeetomal, and outer circuit komolexos-vinterfint-fejka-smycka-kuggis-jeetomal-hub.
Optional branch: hub -> fugoumitak (Fugoumitak Sanctuary / Final Boss).

rooms.name: Hub - The Restaurant and Farm

rooms.name: Island 2 - Jeetomal
rooms.description: The large central mountainous island where quality cattle are raised. Four bridges lead south to the Hub, west to Island 4, north to Island 3, and east to Island 6.

rooms.name: Island 3 - Smycka
rooms.description: A rugged island in the north of the archipelago swept by sea breezes. Bridges connect west to Island 5, south to Island 2, and east to Island 6.

rooms.name: Island 4 - Vinterfint

rooms.name: Island 5 - Fejka

rooms.name: Island 7 (END) - Fugoumitak Sanctuary

_comment_items: [SUBJECT] at least 4 distinct items; at least 2 must be obtainable in-world (= listed in a room's items).
[SUBJECT] items are unique instances: TAKE removes it from the room, DROP puts it back for the others.
[SUBJECT][RFC] items can be referenced by ID or by display name; multi-word names are supported.
[SERVER] id: not empty, unique. name: required.
[SERVER] name must be unique among ALL items AND NPCs (case-insensitive), so 'TAKE <name>' is never ambiguous.
[TEAM] an item placed in no room can never be obtained: place every item somewhere.
id          stable identifier sent to the clients (INVENTORY, LOOK)
name        what players can type: TAKE Flour, TAKE Beef, TAKE flour
description not sent by the server today (LOOK only gives ids): for us and the clients
heal        optional. > 0: USE <item> heals this many HP (never above max HP);
the item is used up and comes back in the room where it spawns.
0 or missing: a normal item (USE answers ERR 408 ITEM_NOT_USABLE).

items.name: Wellington Recipe

_comment_npcs: [SUBJECT] at least 3 distinct NPC roles (e.g. dialogue, quest-giver, enemy).
[SUBJECT] enemy NPCs have varying HP based on their type and difficulty: if you add enemies, give them different hp.
How each role is made in this file:
dialogue NPC   name + dialogue. Players use TALK <npc> (here: waiter - Apprentice Waiter).
quest-giver    any NPC used as 'giver' in a quest below. Players use QUEST <npc> (here: chef_gusto - Chef Gusto).
enemy          "hostile": true + hp + attack (+ defense). Players use ATTACK <npc> (here: wild_guardian and supreme_critic).
[SERVER] id: not empty, unique. name: required, unique among ALL items AND NPCs (case-insensitive).
[SERVER] dialogue: at least one line (TALK goes through the lines one after the other, in a loop).
[SERVER] hostile: needs hp > 0 and attack > 0, and cannot be placed in respawn_room.
[TEAM] keep quest-givers non-hostile: a defeated enemy disappears for 30 seconds.
Combat numbers, to balance enemies:
player at start: 100 HP, attack 10, defense 2
damage of one hit = attack + random(0..4) - defense of the one hit (minimum 1)
one ATTACK = the player hits, then the enemy hits back if still alive
a defeated enemy comes back with full HP after 30 seconds
examples with current data:
- wild_guardian Wild Guardian (60 HP, attack 12, defense 1): guarding mushroom on kuggis.
Player deals ~10 dmg/hit (6 hits to kill), takes ~12 dmg/hit (~70 HP lost without healing).
- supreme_critic Supreme Critic (110 HP, attack 18, defense 2): boss guarding recipe on fugoumitak (END).
Deals ~18 dmg/hit. A fresh player without quest rewards or healing will lose.
Fields: id, name, description (not sent by the server today), dialogue, hostile, hp, attack, defense

_comment_quests: [SUBJECT] at least 2 simple quests (e.g. fetch item, defeat NPC, deliver item).
[SUBJECT] progression, completion and rewards are our own design: they must be explained in the README 'Quest System' section.
[RFC] players use QUEST <npc> and QUESTS. ERR 406 NO_QUEST_AVAILABLE when the NPC has nothing more to give.
How quests work in our server:
- QUEST <giver> gives the next quest of this NPC, shows its progress, or completes it when the goal is done.
- Quests of the same giver are a chain, in the order of this list: the next one is given only after
the previous one is completed.
- Progress is automatic, completion is manual: the player must go back to the giver and type QUEST <giver>.
Types:
fetch   target = an item id. The player must have it in their inventory when they report to the giver.
The item is then taken and goes back to the room where it spawns (other players can do the quest).
A 'deliver' quest is a fetch quest where the item is far from the giver.
defeat  target = a hostile NPC id. The quest must be accepted BEFORE the kill.
Group members in the same room who also have the quest get the credit too.
[SERVER] giver: existing NPC. type: only fetch or defeat.
[SERVER] fetch: target must be an item placed in a room. defeat: target must be a hostile NPC.
[SERVER] description and reward.name are required.
Current progression chain (giver: chef_gusto):
fetch_beef (fetch beef) -> fetch_egg (fetch egg)
defeat_guardian (defeat wild_guardian) -> fetch_mushroom (fetch mushroom)
defeat_critic (defeat supreme_critic) -> fetch_recipe (fetch recipe)
Fields:
id          stable identifier sent to the clients (QUEST, QUESTS)
type        fetch | defeat
giver       NPC id
description text sent to the player
target      item id (fetch) or enemy NPC id (defeat)
reward      name (text sent to the player), max_hp (added to max HP and current HP), attack (added to attack);
max_hp and attack are optional numbers

quests.description: Island 2 (Jeetomal Beef): Go north of the Hub to Island 2 and bring the Beef back to Chef Gusto.
Island 5 (Fejka Eggs): Go all the way northwest to Island 5 and bring the Egg back to Chef Gusto.
Island 6 (Secure Kuggis): Go east to Island 6 and defeat the Wild Guardian.
Island 6 (Kuggis Mushrooms): Bring the Mushroom from Island 6 back to Chef Gusto.
Island 7 - END (The Final Boss): Go east of the Hub to Island 7 and defeat the Supreme Critic guarding the chest.
Island 7 - END (The Culinary Grail): Take the Wellington Recipe from the chest on Island 7 and bring it back to Chef Gusto.
